description: Fix file encoding and line ending issues in international dataset. Files with encoding issues: data/customers.csv (contains José García, François Dupont, Müller Schmidt, Søren Nielsen), data/locations.txt (contains São Paulo, Malmö, Zürich, Montréal), docs/glossary.txt (contains naïve, café, résumé, façade) - convert all to UTF-8. Files with line ending issues: README.md, docs/notes.md, scripts/validate.sh - convert all from CRLF to LF. Use VSCode status bar encoding indicator (bottom-right) to reopen with correct encoding then save as UTF-8. Use status bar CRLF/LF indicator to change line endings. Project standard in .editorconfig: UTF-8 with LF line endings.
